import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console only: must not open, create, or write any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    out = capsys.readouterr()
    assert out.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert out.err == ""


def test_log_line_preserves_level_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_log_line_message_with_brackets_and_spaces(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "  [x]  y ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR]   [x]  y \n"


def test_log_line_prints_only_to_stdout(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "x")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] x\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_single_line_output(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "a")
    log_line("DEBUG", "b")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] a\n[DEBUG] b\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    import builtins
    import io
    import os

    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("file system access is not allowed")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(io, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "open", forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "no files")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] no files\n"
